content.short: Sqwid is an NFT marketplace on the Reef chain that features per-item customizable royalties.
content.description: Sqwid is an NFT marketplace on the Reef chain, an EVM-compatible L1 built with the Substrate framework. Sqwid NFTs follow the ERC1155 standard, enabling a single item to have multiple copies. The platform supports the EIP-2981 royalty standard, allowing creators to set a royalty percentage that automatically applies to future sales. All metadata is stored on Filecoin and IPFS, so the content you buy or sell remains accessible and tamper-resistant.
content.meta: Sqwid is the official NFT marketplace of the Reef chain, an EVM-compatible L1 built on the Substrate framework. Discover Sqwid and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
